niche_preference_profile: This user prefers clean, airy, and well-structured mobile UI with strong visual hierarchy, concise copy, clear primary actions, and balanced spacing. They like light backgrounds, bold titles, prominent buttons, and layouts that feel complete and intentional rather than sparse or cluttered. They generally prefer simple card/group structures, but they are inconsistent about whether they want denser information or more open space depending on the screen type.

criteria.description: Clear title-led layouts with a single dominant focal area, strong section separation, and minimal competing labels or cards.
Short, direct, reassuring copy that reduces explanatory text and keeps onboarding or alert messaging easy to scan.
Primary controls should be visually obvious, high-contrast, and easy to identify, with clear next-step affordance.
Layouts should feel open, balanced, and intentionally filled, avoiding awkward empty areas while still staying uncluttered.
Information should be organized into clear, coherent sections or cards with straightforward grouping and minimal nesting.
Light, airy backgrounds with clean, modern, polished presentation and friendly visual tone rather than heavy or harsh styling.
